anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading system shows no active trades or profit/loss activity despite active strategies, which is unusual for a trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review and potentially restart AI components to ensure they are functioning and contributing to trading decisions.
Evaluate trading strategies and system configurations to ensure they are correctly set up and operational.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve any bottlenecks or inefficient processes.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Restart or troubleshoot the AI components to ensure they are operational and contributing to trading activities.
recommendations.rationale: The AI system is not generating learning cycles or opportunities, which may hinder the platform's ability to adapt and optimize trading strategies.

recommendations.action: Review the configuration and execution of active trading strategies to ensure they are functioning as expected.
recommendations.rationale: No active trades or profit/loss activity suggests potential misconfiguration or issues with strategy execution.
